description: One line of the unchecked ledger under @worktrees/unchecked/<product>/<featureId>.jsonl, one JSON object per line, append-only. An entry is coverage a mission decided not to take: the mission's verification covers the surfaces its done-when journey passes through, and every other unit — and every state of a secondary unit a lane did not reach — is written down here rather than silently skipped. Nothing edits a line: an entry is resolved by appending the same id again with resolvedBy and resolvedAt filled, so the newest line per id is the entry's state (scripts/unchecked.mjs#readUnchecked). scripts/record-unchecked.mjs appends after a done plan or verification branch and scripts/validate-session.mjs#uncheckedLedgerErrors refuses a session whose done branch deferred something the ledger does not hold.

id.description: Derived from what the entry is about (product, feature, unit, state, lane), so recording one receipt twice appends nothing and a later lane that covers it resolves the line it already has.

unit.description: The units.json id the entry stands against.

state.description: The surface state left uncovered, or null when the whole surface is.

tier.description: How much of the mission's journey the entry sits inside, and therefore how heavy it is. `secondary`: a whole unit the journey does not pass through, deferred by the plan that named it. `journey`: a state of a unit the journey does pass through, left unmeasured by the verification that ran it — the journey is only partly proved, which is why a production deploy refuses to run over one (UNCHECKED_OPEN) and passes over a secondary one.

reason.description: Copied from the plan's unit deferral.reason, or from the verifying receipt's own deferral entry; the ledger states no reason of its own.

resolvedBy.description: The branch whose verification covered what the entry named; null while the entry is open.

lane.description: Which proof was not taken. The lane of an operator is scripts/unchecked.mjs#VERIFY_LANES and is stated nowhere else.
